server.name: io.github.SikamikanikoBG/homelab-monitor
server.description: Self-hosted homelab dashboard with a built-in read-only MCP server (hosts, Docker, GPU, services).
server.title: HomeLab Monitor

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the running HomeLab Monitor dashboard (e.g. http://YOUR-HUB:9800)
environmentVariables.name: HOMELAB_MONITOR_URL

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: stdio (default for this package entry) or http
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.connect_http: claude mcp add --transport http homelab http://YOUR-HUB:9810/mcp
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.connect_stdio: docker run -i --rm -e HOMELAB_MONITOR_URL=http://YOUR-HUB:9800 -e MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio sikamikaniko123/homelab-monitor python /app/mcp_server.py
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: HomeLab Monitor is a self-hosted dashboard for AI/homelab rigs. It ships a read-only MCP server (v0.14.0+) inside the same Docker image, serving 12 tools over streamable-HTTP — explore your fleet's hosts, containers, GPU usage, services, and alerts without touching the OS. MIT, no cloud dependency.
